mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM writers WHERE email = #{email}) AS email_exists, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM writers WHERE username = #{username}) AS username_exists
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO writers ( images_id, name, email, username, about, contact_no, website ) VALUES ( #{imagesId}, BTRIM(#{name}), #{email}, BTRIM(#{username}), #{about}, #{contactNo}, #{website} )
mapper.update: UPDATE writers SET images_id = #{imagesId}, name = BTRIM(#{name}), email = #{email}, username = BTRIM(#{username}), about = #{about}, contact_no = #{contactNo}, website = #{website} WHERE id = #{writersId}
